text:
sam: quick heads-up — FinBank POC requires Private deployment but their security team insists on TLS inspection for all outbound L7 traffic. also they want a shortlist of connectivity options + any firewall rules we need them to open. who can sketch playbooks?

ishaan: short list: PrivateLink (preferred for no egress to internet), VPC peering (works if both in same cloud account/region), or TGW + NAT/proxy if they need centralized inspection. tradeoffs: PrivateLink = ENI + SG config, no NAT egress; TGW/proxy = easier for on-prem but adds egress IPs and latency.

katie: for pricing: Private deployment + dedicated capacity incurs platform fee + reserved GPU commit. if they need persistent low-latency, recommend Dedicated commit (monthly). ephemeral POC on-hosted but in VPC can blow up egress. i'll draft a ballpark later. :money_with_wings:

rachel: security notes — TLS inspection breaks cert pinning and harms E2E end-to-end assurances. ask FinBank if they can do selective inspection (only for outbound to unknown destinations). also require KMS integration for keys, audit logging, and proof of segregation of logs for PCI/SOC2.

sam: customer also asked for exact IPs/ports to allow in their firewall. can we give a minimal allowlist for PrivateLink + fallback proxy?

ishaan: yes — minimal rules (example):
```
# PrivateLink (recommended)
Allow outbound TCP 443 to our PrivateLink ENI(s) (we'll provide /32s per endpoint)
Allow inbound from PrivateLink ENI to service SG on TCP 443 (customer-controlled)

# If using SNI proxy / egress proxy
Allow outbound TCP 443 to proxy IP(s): 34.200.216.10/32, 34.200.216.11/32
Allow outbound TCP 443 to Redwood egress pool: 52.10.0.0/20
```
These are placeholders — we'll provide final /32s once the PrivateLink endpoint is provisioned. also recommend SGs that restrict source CIDRs to the app subnets only.

deploy-bot: auto-note: when creating PrivateLink endpoint we create an ENI in each AZ. customers must allow cross-AZ ENI traffic and ensure route table has no NACL blocks.

maria: finance question: for a 30-day POC (expected ~200k tokens/day, moderate concurrency) — rough delta between hosted private vs dedicated? can someone give a quick estimate so i can flag to FinBank?

katie: rough: hosted private (usage billing) ~ usage * token rate + small provisioning fee. Dedicated (reserved) = base commit (~$Xk/mo) + lower per-token. POC likely cheaper on hosted unless they need lat SLOs. i'll send a sketch in an hour.

rachel: security questionnaire item: if they insist on TLS inspection and cannot relax, recommend on-prem appliance hugging the TGW/proxy path; we must document the risk of broken client cert flows and get customer signoff.

sam: ok action items: (1) ishaan to prepare exact firewall allowlist template + PrivateLink ENI IP marshaling (due EOD) (2) katie to produce pricing sketch for hosted vs dedicated POC (due 1h) (3) rachel to bullet security caveats to include in the SOC/QA response (due EOD) — i'll follow up with FinBank. thanks all :thumbsup:

ishaan: noted — will add sample terraform snippet for endpoint later.
